name: Tilopay

evidence.gateway: F02: payment facilitator that processes and settles; the merchant sells its own goods
evidence.billing: F14: Tilopay charges subscriptions on schedule; F15: plans, trials and daily retries up to 30 days
evidence.links: F16: payment links and QR codes made from the panel, no website needed

line: Central American gateway for checkout, recurring payments, and payment links.

free.text: No monthly or annual platform fee; transaction fees apply

cells.countries: Costa Rica, Panama, Guatemala; wider list incomplete
cells.payout: Contract-set frequency; no universal payout delay published
